title: Dataset Release Registry Entry
description: One public data release whose preprocessing is a named KB pipeline (added 2026-11-09). Governs kb/datasets/{dataset_id}.yaml. A dataset phrase resolves to its pipeline with provenance 'via data release'.

aliases.description: Release-specific names (e.g. 'HCP S1200'). recognize() falls back to these.

family.description: The study the release belongs to (e.g. 'hcp_ya', 'abcd').

family_aliases.description: Names of the study as a whole (e.g. 'ABCD Study'). Matched only by recognize_dataset(name, release), never by recognize().

release.description: The release identifier as the release document writes it (e.g. '3.0', 'S1200').

pipeline_version.description: Only where the release document states it.
